elements.name: s10-flow-copy
elements.text:
1. Find under-filled FG in FG_Result.
2. Confirm binding RM in RM_Diagnostic.
3. Compare incremental buy cost in Purchase_Summary.
4. Use Purchase_Detail for procurement handoff.
